# RealRank

> RealRank is the public organic-traffic leaderboard. Sites connect Google Search Console (read-only) and are ranked by verified organic clicks. The default sort is momentum (growth velocity), so a fast-growing small site can outrank a large flat one. Nobody types in a number and nobody uploads a screenshot, so the ranking cannot be faked.

## How the ranking works

Momentum compares a site's last 7 days of organic clicks against the prior 21 days (an average daily rate), weighted by a logarithm of click volume so real growth counts but random noise cannot leapfrog a steady performer. The exact formula is: momentum = (1 + growthRate) x log10(clicks_7d + 1) x 100. A volume view (total clicks over 28 days) is also available. Data comes straight from each site's Google Search Console, refreshed hourly.

## Key pages

- [Leaderboard](https://www.realrank.lol/): The live board, ranked by momentum or volume.
- [How ranking works](https://www.realrank.lol/about): Methodology and the momentum formula.
- [Momentum score calculator](https://www.realrank.lol/momentum-score): Estimate a momentum score from 7- and 28-day clicks.
- [Traffic report card](https://www.realrank.lol/report-card): Instant A to F organic-traffic grade for any domain.
- [Is my traffic real?](https://www.realrank.lol/is-my-traffic-real): Compare third-party traffic estimates against verified Search Console clicks.
- [Founding members](https://www.realrank.lol/founding): The first verified sites on the board.
- [Verified vs pay-to-rank directories](https://www.realrank.lol/best/lol-directories): How RealRank compares to the .lol pay-to-rank boards.
- [Connect Search Console](https://www.realrank.lol/login): Claim a verified rank (read-only Google access).

## For AI agents

- [MCP server](https://www.realrank.lol/api/mcp): A public, read-only Model Context Protocol endpoint. Tools cover momentum leaders, a site's trust profile, site comparisons, and trending sites by category. It exposes verified traffic and ranking data only, never revenue.
- [Agent visibility](https://www.realrank.lol/agent-visibility): What agents can read about RealRank and how to use the MCP server.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://www.realrank.lol/blog): Essays on verified organic traffic, momentum ranking, and the .lol leaderboard trend.

## Notes

- Access to Google Search Console is read-only (the webmasters.readonly scope). It can read search-performance data for properties the owner already controls; it cannot change settings, submit URLs, or write anything.
- Nothing is public until a site owner chooses to publish a property. Sites can be unpublished at any time, and access can be revoked from Google account permissions.
